name: pithy
description: An agent team for building any app on Pithy: a server, a web client, a mobile client and a runner, each on the model you choose. It files what the kit cannot do.

server_model.title: Server agent model
server_model.description: The model the server agent runs on: opus, sonnet, haiku, fable or inherit. Default: sonnet.

server_effort.title: Server agent effort
server_effort.description: How hard the server agent thinks: low, medium, high, xhigh or max. Default: medium.

client_web_model.title: Web client agent model
client_web_model.description: The model the web client agent runs on: opus, sonnet, haiku, fable or inherit. Default: sonnet.

client_web_effort.title: Web client agent effort
client_web_effort.description: How hard the web client agent thinks: low, medium, high, xhigh or max. Default: medium.

client_mobile_model.title: Mobile client agent model
client_mobile_model.description: The model the mobile client agent runs on: opus, sonnet, haiku, fable or inherit. Default: sonnet.

client_mobile_effort.title: Mobile client agent effort
client_mobile_effort.description: How hard the mobile client agent thinks: low, medium, high, xhigh or max. Default: medium.

runner_model.title: Runner agent model
runner_model.description: The model the runner agent runs on: opus, sonnet, haiku, fable or inherit. Default: haiku.

runner_effort.title: Runner agent effort
runner_effort.description: How hard the runner agent thinks: low, medium, high, xhigh or max. Default: low.
